sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:190

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:190:1
items.html: And from their coupling are made the vessels of the Nefashot, and they are the Ofanim etc. Not necessarily the Ofanim, but the whole discernment of the externality of Assiya, namely the firmaments, etc., all of them come out from the coupling of the externality of the Sefirot, called vessels, as above. And in this way, in all the worlds, from the couplings of the inner vessels of the Sefirot, called here self, souls come out; and from the couplings of the external vessels of the Sefirot come out the externality of the worlds, called angels, Serafim, Hayot, and Ofanim, and firmaments and palaces and lands, etc.; for this is the rule: every discernment comes out from the discernment opposite it. And therefore the internality of the worlds, which are the souls of human beings alone, comes out from the internality of the Sefirot. And the externality of the worlds, namely everything that is in the worlds except the souls of human beings, which are the firmaments, palaces, etc., comes out from the externality of the Sefirot.
